PUBLISHER USE NOTE, quoted verbatim from the CKAN notes field: 'Cal-ITP collects the GTFS feeds from a statewide list every night and aggregates it into a statewide table for analysis purposes only. Do not use for trip planner ingestion, rather is meant to be used for statewide analytics and other use cases. Note: These data may or may or may not have passed GTFS-Validation' -- Milexium's use (statewide scheduled-deadhead analytics) is inside that stated intent, and these bytes must NOT be served to a passenger trip planner. SCOPE LIMIT: this grant is Caltrans' over ITS aggregation. The ~200 underlying per-operator feeds keep their own upstream terms; this record does not launder them and is NOT authority to fetch any agency feed directly.
